requirements.limitation: Bounded to the exercised TET4 Total-Lagrangian elastic small-strain cases; no universal asymptotic band is claimed.
Objectivity and invariant checks are accepted only for the recorded TET4 benchmark motions and finite deformation bounds.
The qualified statement is limited to finite, positive-det(F), tested TET4 elastic domains; HEX8 complete-history behavior is excluded.
Equilibrium and residual observations are bounded to accepted TET4 paths and do not establish a universal nonlinear convergence policy.
Finite-difference tangent observations remain bounded to the declared TET4 states and steps; no global tangent tolerance is approved.
Mesh observations are bounded trend evidence; no universal mesh error or monotonicity law is claimed.
Reproducibility and increment sensitivity are recorded for the exercised histories; the HEX8 stop remains an explicit limitation.
The complete compatible external comparison is accepted for TET4 over 16/16 bounded points. HEX8 complete matched-history correlation is not qualified and is excluded.
Branch tracking and turning-point evidence is bounded to the declared TET4 shallow-arch benchmark and remains research-level.
Coarse sensitivity is bounded, but the refined mesh has no comparable observed turning point and the finer probe reaches invalid det(F); no refined extrapolation is claimed.
Checkpoint/restart and rollback are accepted for the recorded turning-point benchmark and are not generalized to all continuation histories.
External evidence is used only where formulation-compatible and remains bounded; unavailable or non-comparable fields are not treated as PASS.

total_lagrangian.domain: declared finite, positive-det(F), bounded TET4 cases covered by the historical evidence and G07 B2/B3
total_lagrangian.external_claim: bounded Code_Aster-compatible displacement/reaction comparison over the recorded 16/16 TET4 points

arc_length.domain: bounded internal branch, turning-point and restart/rollback evidence

qualified_bounded_scope.claim_boundary: No general TL or Arc-Length qualification, no finite nonlinear industrial/general-purpose claim, and no automatic generalization to untested families, meshes, materials, loads or controls.

release_blocker_test.rationale: The excluded and deferred evidence does not invalidate the explicitly narrowed TET4 bounded claims, reveal a solver bug, or create an ambiguous public claim.

failure_groups.observation: The existing G07 B1 runner scripts/run_g07_b1_arc_length.py is 762 lines; no closeout code changed it.
The controlled audit record reports 456 public source documents while the current pre-closeout tree reports 460; this is an existing audit-record mismatch, not a solver failure.

release_blockers_outside_g07: architecture source-line limit for the existing G07 B1 runner

limitations: TL HEX8 is not qualified for complete matched nonlinear history because the deterministic QF path stops at load factor 0.375 and reaches MIN_INCREMENT_REACHED under existing cutback.
ARC-002 refined-mesh turning-point comparability is deferred because the refined declared window did not observe a turning point and finer probing reached invalid det(F).
TET4 stress/strain fields are not externally comparable in the recorded correlation because the integration and sampling measures differ.
TET10 and HEX20 remain research-only for G07; finite-kinematic J2, coupled nonlinear, contact/friction and new physics remain excluded.
No universal load-step, arc-step, mesh, large-deformation or industrial-solver-equivalence claim is made.
Two pre-existing full-regression failures remain release blockers outside G07.
scope_exclusions: TL HEX8 complete matched nonlinear history
ARC-002 refined-mesh turning-point extrapolation and universal step/mesh sensitivity
TET10 and HEX20 qualified G07 claims
finite-kinematic J2 and coupled nonlinear workflows
external stress/strain equivalence where measures are not comparable
general, industrial or production-wide TL/Arc-Length claims
